writeups.content:
# Crack The Gate 1
CyLab Web Exploitation Easy 2026-10-20
!!! tip "Note 💡" We’re in the middle of an investigation. One of our persons of interest, ctf player, is believed to be hiding sensitive data inside a restricted web portal. We’ve uncovered the email address he uses to log in: **`ctf-player@cylabacademy.org`**. Unfortunately, we don’t know the password, and the usual guessing techniques haven’t worked. But something feels off... it’s almost like the developer left a secret way in. Can you figure it out? There is a login page and i dont know the password ! In source code page I found something ![Image](assets/notion/crack-the-gate-1/img_2552aa0626c4.png) I google about Hint 02 and found ROT13 decoder : ![Image](assets/notion/crack-the-gate-1/img_d4618514b7a9.png) I dont know about header usages !!! So ive to analysis i use a extension to add header ![Image](assets/notion/crack-the-gate-1/img_023e2604e085.png) and try too loggin with that email and rand pass ! ![Image](assets/notion/crack-the-gate-1/img_57cb82c01eb4.png) GOT IT

writeups.description: Input sanitization flaws and payload crafting for web application flags.
writeups.content:
# n0s4n1ty 1
CyLab Web Exploitation Easy 2026-10-20
Web Exploitation `Easy` pico2025 !!! tip "Note ⚙" A developer has added profile picture upload functionality to a website. However, the implementation is flawed, and it presents an opportunity for you. Your mission, should you choose to accept it, is to navigate to the provided web page and locate the file upload area. Your ultimate goal is to find the hidden flag located in the **`/root`** directory. Lets start : accroding to descriptions, the upload is vernable maybe i need php upload revershell . ![Image](assets/notion/nosanity/img_a5b0d880a3cd.png) setting up Listener , * `l`: Listen mode. * `v`: Verbose output. * `n`: Do not resolve DNS names (speeds up the connection). * `p 4444`: The port number you will specify in your PHP script. Saved the following template as rev.php and upload . php working but not connecting to my pc. maybe beacuse of private ip eventhough i used vpn but same problm !! So i write a basic script to check echo works or not: `` ![Image](assets/notion/nosanity/img_9d75daccac0c.png) and its working ! now need to access now checking echo shell_exec('whoami'); this work or not, YESS works. now using sudo -l as the hint mentioned ! ![Image](assets/notion/nosanity/img_6c3b653ea0bc.png) using sudu ls /root i found flag.txt ![Image](assets/notion/nosanity/img_2364e6b7f992.png) and found the flag. ![Image](assets/notion/nosanity/img_f6abcc74969e.png)

writeups.title: Old Sessions
writeups.description: Session timeout controls, cookie inspection, and privilege escalation.
writeups.content:
# Old Sessions
CyLab Web Exploitation Easy 2026-10-20
`Easy` picoCTF 2026 Descriptions : !!! tip "Note 💡" Proper session timeout controls are critical for securing user accounts. If a user logs in on a public or shared computer but doesn’t explicitly log out (instead simply closing the browser tab), and session expiration dates are misconfigured, the session may remain active indefinitely. The session expire date leading to cookies ! Ok in the browser , theres login and registration option . I register with with user , pass : and login ![Image](assets/notion/old-sessions/img_a030fa11493b.png) I found ADMIN comment , and cookies of my id . ![Image](assets/notion/old-sessions/img_8edb8f6ae6ba.png) OHH! I missed a strange comment by mary_jones ![Image](assets/notion/old-sessions/img_2e4411fd34f7.png) In that page i found admin cookies 1) session:`pdQcI8hN6T0daaqZkThhaeB9frzGAF8iMWXTfONYF8Q`, {'_permanent': True, 'key': 'admin'} changed the cookies of my login id to admin cookies ![Image](assets/notion/old-sessions/img_3725ac135543.png) and Im in ![Image](assets/notion/old-sessions/img_78a9e0f969c0.png)
